rows.text: 1 mole = 6.022×10²³ entities (Avogadro constant, Nₐ). Molar mass (M) is g·mol⁻¹; for a compound M = Σ(atomic masses).  ·  n (mol) = mass/M = volume(ideal gas, STP)/22.4 L = N/Nₐ.
